title: Core cost-per-success benchmark
description: Six small, client-neutral tasks covering repository discovery, code change, tests, documentation retrieval, and noisy-output analysis.

requirements: Use the same repository commit, model, client version, permission profile, environment, and task order for every arm.
Start every task from a fresh checkout or worktree at the recorded commit so the fixture and Git verification commands begin clean.
Run each complete arm at least three times in fresh sessions.
Record a task as successful only when every listed success criterion passes.

tasks.prompt: Explain this fixture's architecture, public functions, test layout, and the two intentionally broken behaviors. Do not modify files.
success_criteria: Identifies app.py as the implementation and tests/test_app.py as its contract.
Identifies the discount arithmetic defect and the unimplemented email normalization behavior.

tasks.prompt: Fix discounted_total so it implements the documented flat-discount behavior. Keep validation and rounding behavior unchanged. Run the focused discount tests.
success_criteria: A subtotal of 100 with a discount of 15 returns 85.
Only the relevant implementation is changed.

tasks.prompt: Implement normalize_customer_email according to README.md. Preserve the function signature and add no dependency. Run its focused tests.
success_criteria: A value without exactly one @ raises ValueError.

tasks.prompt: Run the complete fixture test suite, diagnose every failure, and make the smallest implementation changes that satisfy the existing contract. Do not weaken or delete tests.
success_criteria: No test is removed, skipped, or weakened.
No dependency or network access is added.

tasks.prompt: Using the fixture documentation, explain why totals use decimal half-up rounding, where that rule is authoritative, and what behavior a code change must preserve. Do not modify files.
success_criteria: States that monetary totals round to two decimal places using decimal half-up.

tasks.prompt: Analyze logs/ci.log. Report the failing job, root cause, first corrective action, and the irrelevant repeated noise. Do not paste the full log and do not modify files.
success_criteria: Identifies unit-tests as the failing job.
Identifies an expected 85.00 versus actual 115.00 discount assertion.
Recommends correcting the discount arithmetic before rerunning the focused test.
Summarizes rather than reproducing the repeated cache lines.
